guides.title: Box Breathing
guides.description: A simple technique to calm your nervous system.
steps: Sit comfortably with your back straight.
Inhale slowly through your nose for a count of 4.
Hold your breath for a count of 4.
Exhale slowly through your mouth for a count of 4.
Hold your breath for a count of 4.

guides.title: Mindful Observation
guides.description: A guided meditation to bring awareness to the present moment.
steps: Find a quiet place to sit or lie down.
Close your eyes and take a few deep breaths.
Bring your attention to the sounds around you. Notice them without judgment.
Shift your attention to the physical sensations in your body.
Focus on your breath, feeling the rise and fall of your chest.
If your mind wanders, gently guide it back to your breath.

guides.title: Gentle Morning Stretches
guides.description: A sequence of simple yoga poses to start your day.
steps: Start with Cat-Cow pose to warm up your spine.
Move into Downward-Facing Dog, pedaling your feet.
Step forward into a low lunge on each side.
Come to a seated position and do a gentle spinal twist.
Finish with a few moments in Child's Pose.
